_doc: three.js metres: +x east, -z north, +y up; ground at the tower = 0. Generated by env_20_build.py.

tower.note: tower footprint ~9.5 m square at the base, stairs rise inside it

gate.note: gate in the stair-foot fence; the Lost Hiker ends up here

ravine_overlook.note: rock outcrop with an old railing; ravine floor ~35 m below, body is visible from here on Day 2

spring.note: pipe spring into a mossy half-barrel

creek_bridge.note: log footbridge with a hand rail

weeper_rock.note: on the FAR bank, 25 m off-trail, big mossy boulder; must be visible from the cab (bearing ~163 deg) through a cleared sightline, and from the bridge

burn_scar.note: area radius ~70 m of snags and black ground; the trail crosses it

trailhead.note: gravel lot, mailbox, ranger station (door faces the lot), truck parking

weeperRock.note: the rock prop is veg_rocks_boulder scaled so its top is at rockTopY; the Weeper sits on it facing the bridge (and the tower beyond)

sightlines.note: keep trees out of this corridor so the rock is visible from the cab at ~200 m

propPlacements.note: span along the trail across the creek
door faces west, onto the lot
